$comment: What logix-core is made of: each tool's pinned upstream release: files, URL and run folders per platform (path: the PATH folders, relative to the component, the first holding its programs; ../ reaches another component; env: variables naming folders, relative to the component, per platform where needed), or one value for every platform (elkjs). Changed only by pull request (docs/design.md, Processes). scripts/build.py reads it. Boards aren't here: they're the logix-catalog package. The list of FPGAs the tools can build is generated from their databases (scripts/fpgas.py).

oss-cad-suite.description: YosysHQ OSS CAD Suite: yosys, nextpnr, icestorm, Project Trellis, Apycula, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GTKWave, openFPGALoader and more

verible.description: CHIPS Alliance Verible: the Verilog formatter and language server

elkjs.description: ELK (the Eclipse Layout Kernel) for JavaScript: lays out Logix Engine's design diagrams, run by the engine itself
